pitfalls.summary: Wix has no native podcast entity; episodes migrate as a CMS collection and audio files as media. Decided by Spec Owner 2026-08-16: CMS is the confirmed migration model for content.podcast (collection + media files), not a stopgap — this entity's candidateTargetRefs (cms/collection, cms/data-item) are the signed mapping, and the capability's former pending-register note is retired. The consequence still worth surfacing at review: no podcast player/feed reappears automatically on Wix; the episodes arrive as CMS data.

/ssp/v1/podcast (singular) is the show's settings/feed object, not a record collection; the durable records are the episodes (verified live 2026-08-10 on SSP 3.16.3 — the previously declared /ssp/v1/podcasts route does not exist).

dataRoutePatterns.reason: Seriously Simple Podcasting routes expose durable podcast records

quirks: Episode audio is referenced by URL in record fields; media reachability rules apply as for any external media URL.
